scientific.integrity: The proof is symbolic. It starts from the focal paper's ground-state identity and shell measures, derives an exact radial shell formula, and then applies the finite Dirichlet-path spectral gap plus a telescoping estimate. Numerical checks were used only as sanity checks and do not replace any infinite or asymptotic proof.
scientific.limitations: The result is restricted to radial Bruhat--Schwartz functions supported on the finite annulus \(A_N\). It proves explicit two-sided bounds and the exact \((N+1)^{-2}\) decay order of the best radial annular remainder constant, but not its exact multiplicative constant and not the corresponding nonradial or nonlinear \(L^q\) problem.

title: Quadratic radial annular stability for the p-adic sharp Hardy deficit
